page_title: GEN 2-1 SAS | Genoa v Sassuolo 12/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' The game has begun to heat up. Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sebastian Otoa (Genoa) comes onto the pitch so that Stefano Sabelli can be given a rest.
87' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ismael Kone as he is replaced by Luca Moro (Sassuolo).
84' 2 - 1 Goal! Junior Messias rounded the goalkeeper and sent a sweet pass to Caleb Ekuban (Genoa), who had an easy finish to put it into an empty net. 2:1.
81' Fabio Grosso decides to make a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti will be replaced by Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo).
81' We are about to witness a substitution. Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) is replacing Josh Doig.
80' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
80' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul after Aaron Martin (Genoa) hacks down one of his opponents. Sassuolo have a free kick.
78' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
76' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
76' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Arijanet Muric stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
75' Substitution. Vitinha did his best and is replaced by Junior Messias (Genoa).
74' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Antonio Rapuano saw the whole situation. A free kick to Sassuolo.
74' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
74' The fouls committed statistics – 8:11.
71' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle and it's Leo Ostigard (Genoa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Sassuolo are awarded a free kick.
70' Wow, what an escape. Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
68' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
67' Fabio Grosso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) replacing Nemanja Matic.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) is coming onto the pitch as Sebastian Walukiewicz cannot continue after picking up an injury.
66' A clumsy foul by Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Sassuolo.
66' The game is interrupted as Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) is flagged offside.
63' Genoa fail to score from a corner as Arijanet Muric (Sassuolo) leaps to collect the ball.
62' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Genoa, play can continue.
62' There's a break in play and referee Antonio Rapuano must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Genoa using VAR. This could be interesting!
62' PENALTY APPEAL after Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
60' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Aaron Martin (Genoa) took the corner.
60' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. It will be a corner kick for Genoa.
59' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Sassuolo players have a reason to celebrate!
59' The Sassuolo players halt their celebrations as referee Antonio Rapuano makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
57' 1 - 1 Goal! Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:1.
57' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
57' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sassuolo.
57' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Sassuolo have a corner.

56' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
55' Substitution. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) replaces Lorenzo Colombo.
55' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Tommaso Baldanzi and he is replaced by Aaron Martin (Genoa).
55' Substitution. Ruslan Malinovskyi walks off the pitch and Patrizio Masini (Genoa) comes on as a substitute.
55' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
54' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) is penalised for holding. Antonio Rapuano signals a set piece. Genoa earn a free kick.
53' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
51' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is flagged for offside.
51' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
46' The whistle blows and Antonio Rapuano starts the second half.
45+2' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is shown a red card even though he is not on the pitch. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
45+2' Unsportsmanlike conduct. Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) is shown a red card off the pitch!
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
43' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

43' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Vitinha (Genoa) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Genoa.
41' The resulting corner from Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
41' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) on the edge of the box. The linesman points to the corner flag, Genoa are going to take it.
40' What was Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

38' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
37' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Genoa.
36' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
33' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Josh Doig (Sassuolo) was quite harsh and Antonio Rapuano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
31' Tommaso Baldanzi (Genoa) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.

30' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and releases a quick shot to the bottom left corner. His promising effort is kept out by Arijanet Muric, who pulls off a stunning save!

29' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Justin Bijlow. This effort really didn't trouble him.
29' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) takes a short corner kick.
29' The resulting corner from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Sassuolo can continue in their attacking effort.

28' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the top left corner. Justin Bijlow is alert and denies him with a nice save. Sassuolo win a corner.
28' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
27' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Arijanet Muric.
26' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) jumps into a tackle and Antonio Rapuano signals a foul. Genoa are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

25' Tommaso Baldanzi (Genoa) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Arijanet Muric pulls off an easy save.
24' A lofted cross from Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
21' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) produces a shot from a long-range free kick, but it flies high over the crossbar.
21' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) is able to continue to play.
20' The game is interrupted now, Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
20' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is very lucky to stay on the pitch after using excessive force to bring down his opponent with a two-footed challenge.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! Tommaso Baldanzi slips it to Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) on the edge of the box and he finds the top right corner with a great effort. The score is 1:0.
16' Vitinha (Genoa) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
16' There's an opportunity for Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

15' Vitinha (Genoa) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Arijanet Muric guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The linesman makes the right call and Genoa will have a corner.

14' Justin Bijlow makes a brilliant save! Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by keeper!
13' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
12' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
9' What a chance that is! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar.
8' Tommaso Baldanzi (Genoa) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. A free kick has been awarded to Sassuolo.

6' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. Josh Doig (Sassuolo) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
5' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Rapuano had an easy-decision to make.
5' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

2' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Genoa, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Genoa will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Antonio Rapuano.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
